description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Smartsheet is hiring a Software Engineer I to build full-stack services and solve distributed systems problems. The role contributes to product architecture and features while using AI tools to improve engineering workflows and team efficiency.
Software Engineer I building full-stack services and distributed systems with React, Kotlin, AWS, and Kubernetes

Responsibilities:
• Build scalable front-end and back-end services for the next generation of applications at Smartsheet (Kotlin, Java, Typescript, React)
• Solve challenging distributed systems problems and work with modern cloud infrastructure (AWS, Kubernetes)
• Take part in code reviews and architectural discussions as you work with other software engineers and product managers
• Forge a strong partnership with product management and other key areas of the business
• Enhance existing application code with new features and strike a balance when making technical decisions (build vs refactor vs simplify)
• Actively use AI tools to improve personal and team efficiency across coding, testing, design, and troubleshooting, exploring AI integration opportunities within team processes and features, and coaching others on effective AI use

Requirements:
• 1+ years software development experience building highly scalable, highly available applications
• 1+ years of programming experience with full stack technologies such Java, Kotlin, Python or TypeScript
• 1+ years of experience with cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, etc.)
• Experience developing, documenting, and supporting REST APIs
• 6+ months professional experience leveraging AI to improve personal productivity in service of building complex SaaS feature sets
• A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field or equivalent practical experience
• Adaptable as priorities or problems change
• Ready to take ownership of your work and grow into bigger challenges
• A clear written and verbal communicator, able to explain your thinking in code reviews, documentation, and team discussions
• Legally eligible to work in the U.S. on an ongoing basis
